title: Pulsar GiGi H20 Variable Voltage Mini 510 Battery
description:
PULSAR DL V5 ALSO AVAILABLE

Enjoy ultimate versatility with the GiGi H20 510 battery. While maintaining its discreet portable size, this version of our popular GiGi vape battery gives you the ability to directly connect to your glass-on-glass water pipe with the included removable 14/19mm male adapter. The fast charging USB-C port and 500mAh battery keep you going all day so you can vape on-the-go or sit back and relax at home while you take a hit from your GiGi water pipe combo.

Pulsar GiGi 510 Features:
Stealthy 2.15″ Profile
500mAh Battery
Spring-Laded 510 Threading
Pre-Heat Function
Variable Voltage (2.6V, 3.4V and 4.0V)
Fast USB-C Charging
14/19mm Water Pipe Adapter (Heat-Resistant Acrylic Material)
Works with 0.5ml and 1.0ml Cell Cartridges (Not Included)

What’s in the Box:
1x – Pulsar Gigi Variable Voltage 500mAh Mini 510 Battery
1x – 14/19mm Water Pipe Adapter
1x – Charging Cable
